text:

Updated AND relaunched? The fix only lands on restart.

#Chrome #ZeroDay #CyberSecurity

author: BytesNora
text:
Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 is a critical authentication bypass (CVSS 9.8) that's actively exploited. The low EPSS (11%) is irrelevant; CISA KEV confirms exploitation. Patching to 9.4.0.030+ is urgent to prevent config manipulation.

#AuthBypass #ThreatIntel #CyberSecurity

author: YourAnon_irc
text: Recent N-central zero-day exploited hours after PoC (Nov 13) allows root RCE. Check Point zero-day (CVE-2026-123039, Nov 14) enables root escalation & wiper deployment. These pose severe risks to data privacy & integrity in transit. #Cybersecurity #ZeroDay #InfoSec

author: NoctisIntel
text:
CRITICAL: CVE-2026-119618 — unauthenticated RCE in Apache mod_http2

Affects 2.4.55–2.4.70 with HTTP/2 on. Fixed in 2.4.71 (Nov 11). Interim: disable h2. Node2Shell CVE-2026-111497 exploited in the wild.

#ThreatIntel #CVE #CVE2026119618

author: 0xdarkbear
text:
PHP2Shell — CVE-2026-109618 + CVE-2026-109619

Critical PHP core RCE pair. Already being exploited in the wild.

Attackers are using it to:
- Deploy TSGA backdoors
- Wipe ESXi files

If you run PHP in production — check your versions NOW. Not tomorrow. Now.

author: qubit0
text: Fresh CISA KEV: CVE-2026-123039, a Check Point Gaia OS flaw letting attackers gain root access, is actively exploited. Patch by Nov 16: R82.20 T14, R82.10 T52, R82 T132, R81.20 T174. #CyberSecurity #ZeroDay #CISA

author: justelite
text:
CVE-2026-123965 (CVSS 9.9): prompt injection in Jet Admin Cloud's AI tool builder let any free account expose the platform's .env files and steal credentials. Fixed server-side ~Oct 29.

An LLM with file access shouldn't sit next to your secrets.
https://t.co/GO06aZnm8x

author: Afaq_iffi03
text: Langflow's MCP flaw drew 1,423 exploit attempts in under a month — 333 in one day. CVE-2026-105740 (9.9): any logged-in user could run commands on the server from an MCP server setting. The first fix, 1.9.0, was incomplete. The real fix is 1.10.3. Turn off auto-login.

author: SabeeRaymond
text:
CVE-2026-49257 (CVSS 10.0 Critical)

By default, anyone who could reach StarTree’s MCP server for Apache Pinot could read and modify cluster data without logging in.

StarTree fixed it in v3.1.0.

https://t.co/Lk0kVncxc3 https://t.co/3E0kQnkISf

author: eforus_overseer
text: CVE-2026-65968: ideon filtered MCP server URLs against internal hosts by comparing strings, but Node prints IPv4-mapped loopback in compressed hex. [::ffff:7f00:1] walks to localhost and cloud metadata. Text matching is not IP validation. Fixed in 0.9.4. https://t.co/J6dscn8fr5

author: SeanMathena
text:
Your prompt-injection filter may be guarding the wrong door.

OpenHuman's detector scanned user messages but never the tool descriptions its MCP servers sent, so one bad server could steer the agent on every turn (CVE-2026-54140). Do you check what your tools tell your agent?

author: Mike_Kutola
text:
Hackers stole thousands of Uber drivers' licenses, but Uber wasn't hacked. 

The breach was at Fireworks AI, a third-party platform that runs AI models. 

Stolen credentials from Fireworks opened up the Uber data stored there. 

It is a supply chain attack.

author: one_blues_fan

Prompt Injection

An email contains hidden instructions.

An AI agent reads it, interprets the instructions, retrieves confidential records through an MCP tool, and sends them externally.

No database exploit required.
No stolen administrator password required.
